failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month_start,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
month_comparison AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_start)::int AS month_num,
         MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_start) = 2017) AS cnt_2017,
         MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_start) = 2018) AS cnt_2018
  FROM monthly_counts
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month_num AS month,
       cnt_2018 - cnt_2017 AS growth
FROM month_comparison
WHERE cnt_2017 IS NOT NULL
  AND cnt_2018 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_num
LIMIT 12;

failures.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT
  w.warehouse_name,
  r.region_name,
  b.brand_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS product_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = p.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

failures.question: 默认收货地址所在州和客户登记州是否一致的订单量对比，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.state = c.customer_state THEN o.order_id END) AS matched_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.state <> c.customer_state THEN o.order_id END) AS mismatched_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN shipping_addresses sa ON sa.customer_id = c.customer_id AND sa.is_default = true
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC
LIMIT 20;
